name: Dana Snow

appearance.hair: Long blonde hair that flows like a golden waterfall
appearance.eyes: Blue eyes that burn like azure flames when angry
appearance.face: Straight nose, thin lips, gentle appearance despite fierce nature
appearance.body: Slim, lithe figure with small chest. Superhuman physical abilities despite delicate frame.
appearance.civilian_outfit: Various casual clothes, often blends in as a foreigner in Japan
appearance.hero_costume: Originally wore her father's Milkman outfit: hat with long brim, black leather coat, white gloves, navy blue pants, long brown boots, black mask covering face. After being exposed, wears a formfitting black leotard.

personality.demeanor: Uses a hoarse voice changer to disguise herself as male. Fiercely dedicated to avenging her father. Raised herself to be morally upright, even avoiding masturbation. Deeply proud of her hero father's legacy.

abilities.superhuman_speed: Reflexes and speed far beyond normal humans, can dodge scythe attacks
abilities.superhuman_strength: Powerful punch that could launch a heavyweight wrestler
abilities.superhuman_durability: Body is resistant to slashing attacks — Cream Reaper's scythes could not cut her skin
abilities.offbeat_physiology: Inherited Offbeat powers from her father Roy Snow, the original Milkman

background: Daughter of Roy Snow, the original Milkman — a minor but admirable American hero who guarded the small rural city of Bell Valley. The Cream Reaper destroyed the Milkman's milk farm in Bell Valley, then killed her father and chopped his body into pieces. Using documents her father left behind as a will, 18-year-old Dana tracked the Cream Reaper to Japan to avenge him. She adopted her father's Milkman identity and disguised herself as male.

relationships.roy_snow: Father, the original Milkman. Killed by the Cream Reaper. She idolized him.
relationships.flare_kirara: Fellow captive at the milk farm. Fought alongside her.
